items.title: SQL inline constraint semantics: honour PRIMARY KEY fully, refuse the rest loudly
evidence: Pre-existing since audit: inline PK reaches catalogue; NOT NULL/CHECK/UNIQUE/DEFAULT/REFERENCES refused with actionable diagnostic (Option B)

New: conflicting inline vs WITH primary_key is refused (was: WITH silently won); multiple inline PRIMARY KEY columns refused with composite WITH form in the diagnostic; table-level constraints refused with the supported form named; inline PK canonicalised into the properties bag so it survives the catalog JSON round trip (was silently dropped on reload - real defect found during this work); upsert planning binds against an inline-only key
Mutation-checked: reverting catalog.cpp+ast_builder.cpp to pre-change semantics fails exactly the 4 new gate tests
items.result_revision: committed post-baseline (feat(sql): inline PRIMARY KEY is one honest declaration)

items.title: Reject unavailable connectors before deployment (local plan-time + cluster-authoritative submission)
evidence: check_connector_availability (src/cluster/connector_availability.cpp) gates Coordinator::submit_job before planning/allocation; availability read from the registries the job deploys against (bundle-aware), never a hardcoded list; message names the connector, this build's available source/sink connectors (capability registry) and the CLINK_WITH_* rebuild flag

Cluster-authoritative by construction: the gate runs in the submission-owning process (in-proc coordinator for clink run; target coordinator for POST /api/v1/jobs/spec and /jobs/sql); GET /api/v1/connectors already serves the cluster manifest to CLIs

8 tests in tests/test_connector_availability.cpp (missing connector, registry-decides/CLI-vs-cluster, runner-only registration, non-connector pass-through, always-built pass, longest-prefix vocabulary + boundary, vocabulary-completeness pin over declared capabilities, coordinator-level pre-deploy rejection) + SqlPhysical.ASourceOnlyConnectorRequestedAsASinkIsRefused pins the role mismatch; guarantee gate already pins unsupported exactly-once requests
Mutation-checked: gate call removed from submit_job compiles and fails the coordinator-level test; core label 2170/2170 green with the gate in place

items.title: Adaptive unaligned-checkpoint wiring: measured backpressure drives the existing resolver in clink's own runtimes
evidence: checkpoint::AdaptiveModePolicy (header-only): threshold + consecutive-window hysteresis both directions + bounded history + switch counter; deterministic, driven by synthetic pressure in tests

In-process wiring: CheckpointCoordinator::enable_adaptive_mode(pressure_fn) behind the existing set_mode_resolver seam; Dag::channel_pressure_fn() = max depth/capacity across runner input channels; trigger() emits clink_ckpt_mode_total{mode} and clink_ckpt_adaptive_switch_total

Cluster wiring: CheckpointAlignment::Adaptive; coordinator trigger sweep observes last completed checkpoint duration / interval and stamps TriggerCheckpointMsg.barrier_mode_plus1 (trailing wire field, 0 = legacy/static); DeployMsg.adaptive_barrier_mode (trailing, before the epoch per contract) makes sources forward the injected stamp instead of re-stamping; per-op overrides still win; lint covers Adaptive-without-periodic

Tests: 8 AdaptiveModePolicy behaviours incl. spike-no-switch and hysteresis both ways; wire round-trips + 3 tail-truncation compat shapes; mode-flip correctness rests on the aligner's per-barrier pinning proven in test_co_operator_unaligned
Mutation-checked: hysteresis mutant (switch on first pressured window) compiles and fails the policy suite; core label 2179/2179 green
